title: Planning interview: one shared file that prd-to-tickets and wayfinder both follow
story: The interview that settles every open question before stories are filed now lives in one shared file. /prd-to-tickets follows it as before, and /wayfinder now runs the same interview before it files stories; a hard-to-reverse question there becomes a new decision ticket, and the answers already given are saved on the map.
no_qa_reason: Skill instructions only; a suite check guards that both skills point at the one file.
